A refreshed gold identity and a living background.

## Changed

- **New featherdrop logo.** The mark is now a gold medallion with the feather
  carved out as negative space, rendered as a crisp inline SVG that scales with
  a single gold gradient (`components/Logo.tsx`). The favicon (`app/icon.svg`),
  the README banner and the Unraid template icon (`.github/assets/`) were all
  re-rendered to match. Self-hosters can still override the mark with their own
  image via `BRAND_LOGO_URL`.
- **The ambient aurora now drifts.** The gold/violet background glow breathes
  with a slow, 34-second motion (`app/globals.css`), and holds still for
  visitors who prefer reduced motion.
